heading: What’s inside, for hospitality
title: The same system, built for how guests choose where to stay.

items.name: Weekly Pulse
items.text: A one page read on how your property showed up this week, and the one thing to do next.

items.name: Lift Score
items.text: One number that shows whether guests are finding you more easily than last week.

items.name: AI Shortlist
items.text: Know whether AI trip planners recommend you, for which kinds of stays, and who they name instead.

items.name: Map Reach
items.text: Where you appear in Google Maps and Google Hotels across the areas your guests search from.

items.name: Site Read
items.text: Make sure Google and AI describe your rooms, amenities, dining and policies correctly.

items.name: Daily Presence
items.text: Story led posts around your seasons, events and offers, so guests feel the stay before they book.

items.name: Market Survey
items.text: Your comp set, side by side: who guests see first and who earns the booking click.

items.name: Review Desk
items.text: Every review answered in your brand voice, with the themes guests mention flagged for your team.

items.name: Snapshot
items.text: Calls, direct booking clicks and direction requests from Google, in plain language.

items.name: ClearView
items.text: Your social report: what posted, what guests engaged with and what changes next.
